about: Curated products of the catalog importer (docs/design/13-anvisa-catalog.md section 7): common Brazilian baby products that are missing or ambiguous in ANVISA's registered-medicines file. Imported with status 'curated' and source 'curated', shown as 'Curated list (not reviewed by a pharmacist)'. NOT reviewed by a pharmacist or pediatrician: every entry keeps reviewed=false until such a review, and must not be trusted before it. Each entry: id (stable key, lower-case letters, digits, dashes; never reuse or change it), name (display name; a name that ANVISA uses for a product with other ingredients must be made distinct, e.g. with 'Solução Nasal Salina'), form (drops, syrup, tablet, powder, spray, ointment, suppository, inhaler, other), ingredients (active-ingredient spellings of the curated substance map, pt-BR), reviewed, basis (where the composition comes from: a primary source or the owner's statement). Never add a dose or an indication. The concentration printed on the label may be recorded in 'strength' (composition, e.g. '9 mg/mL (0,9%)'), never an amount to give. Never guess an ingredient from a name. Optional fields: strengths (the STRUCTURED concentration the alternatives rule compares: one item per ingredient, all of them or none, {ingredient, amount, unit} with units such as 'mg/mL', 'mL/mL', '%', or {ingredient, strain} for a probiotic strain; fill it only where the label or the basis states the amount, never guess; a missing list means strength not known), strength (concentration exactly as printed on the label), packageSize (as printed, e.g. '100 mL'), category (medicine, homeopathic or supplement: what the label says it is; a homeopathic product or a supplement is never an equivalent of a medicine), aliasOf (the id of another entry: this entry is only another name people use for that product, imported as an alias so that searching the name finds the product; keep the id, never reuse it), officialName (the exact ANVISA name to look up when it differs from name), registration (nine-digit ANVISA registration to look up instead), route (oral, nasal, topical...), anvisaCheck (the last result of the machine cross-check `verify-curated` against ANVISA open data: date, status, evidence references; only status VERIFIED means the composition agrees with an active official registration, and it is NOT a pharmacist or pediatrician review, which stays reviewed=false until a person does it).

products.name: Flygas
products.basis: Owner's wording for the Biolab product 'Fly Gotas' (packaging photo provided by the owner, 2026-10-23): kept as an alias so that searching 'Flygas' finds Fly Gotas. There is no product named Flygas in ANVISA's registered-medicines file or the CMED price list (checked 2026-10-22). Earlier basis: owner statement (2026-10-21), Flygas is similar to simeticona, which is similar to Luftal.

products.name: Luftal
products.basis: CMED price list TA_PRECO_MEDICAMENTO.csv (2026-10-09): LUFTAL, presentation registration 1739000090031, substance SIMETICONA, emulsion with dropper. Its registration rows in DADOS_ABERTOS_MEDICAMENTOS.csv are all 'Inativo', so the official import leaves it out. Owner statement as for Flygas. Strength: the four CMED drops presentations of LUFTAL (173900009) read '75 MG ML EMU OR ... GOT X 15 ML' (the slash is missing in the file; the importer's parser reads it as unknown, so this value was entered by hand), consistent with other simethicone drops in CMED ('75 MG/ML').

products.name: Colidis
products.basis: Packaging photo provided by the owner, 2026-10-23 (Aché): 'Suplemento alimentar em suspensão gotas', Limosilactobacillus reuteri DSM 17938, content 10 mL, 'Alívio da cólica em bebês de 0 a 6 meses de idade' (age claim as printed; not checked by anyone). Also the manufacturer page https://www.ache.com.br/produto/suplementos-alimentares/colidis/ (checked 2026-10-22): a food supplement (not a registered medicine), drops. It is not simethicone. Label of the shop: 'Suplemento Probiótico Infantil Colidis Gotas 10ml'.

products.name: Sorine Solução Nasal Salina
products.basis: The saline Sorine products (e.g. Sorine SSC nasal spray) are notified low-risk products without registration or ingredient in the ANVISA file, while the registered 'Sorine' (1.0573.0050) is naphazoline, a decongestant. The inactive registration 1.0573.0352 'SORINE H' lists cloreto de sódio. Composition from retail listings and the coordinator, not a primary source: check the box.

products.name: Sorine Solução Nasal Salina
products.basis: As for the Sorine saline spray (coordinator request: spray and drops).

products.name: Rinosoro Solução Nasal Salina
products.basis: CMED price list (2026-10-09): RINOSORO SIC, presentation registration 1781700810141, nasal solution spray; its registration rows (cloreto de sódio) are 'Inativo' and the other Rinosoro products are notified without ingredient in the ANVISA file. Concentration varies by product: check the box.

products.name: Rinosoro Solução Nasal Salina
products.basis: Inactive ANVISA registrations of RINOSORO list cloreto de sódio; the active 'RINOSORO GOTAS' row is a notified product without ingredient. Coordinator request: spray and drops. Check the box.

products.name: Rinosoro Jet Infantil
products.basis: Packaging photo provided by the owner, 2026-10-23: 'Rinosoro jet Infantil', solução de cloreto de sódio 9,0 mg/mL, concentração 0,9%, 'Fluidificante e descongestionante nasal', 'Uso pediátrico', solução, uso nasal, content 100 mL, 'jato suave para bebês e crianças'. Shop label: 'Rinosoro Jet Infantil 0,9% Descongestionante Spray Jato Suave 100ml'. Isotonic (0,9%) saline: not the same as other Rinosoro concentrations. Official lookup is by the notified brand name 'RINOSORO JET' (active, no ingredient listed), which does not say whether it is the Infantil presentation: the match is by name only.

products.name: Sorine Jet Baby
products.basis: Packaging photo provided by the owner, 2026-10-23 (Aché): 'solução de cloreto de sódio 0,9%', 'Fluidificante e descongestionante nasal', 'Uso pediátrico acima de 0 (zero) dias' (partly legible: 'acima de 0 dias'; age claim as printed, not checked by anyone), 'Sem conservantes', 'Jato contínuo suave', 100 mL. Shop label: 'Sorine Infantil Jet Baby Descongestionante Spray 100ml'. The plain name 'Sorine' is naphazoline in some presentations (registration 1.0573.0050): this is the saline Jet Baby product. Second source (2026-10-23, pharmacy retailer product page, Pague Menos, pasted by the owner; facts only): active ingredient cloreto de sódio 0,9% (9 mg/mL), excipient purified water, sterile, no preservatives, isotonic, spray 100 mL, manufacturer Aché, age indication 'uso adulto e pediátrico', indicated as fluidificante e descongestionante nasal. The 9 mg/mL structured strength is the retailer's equivalent of the printed 0,9% (w/v saline: 0,9 g per 100 mL). The retailer's age indication and the box ('uso pediátrico acima de 0 dias', partly legible) agree that it is usable from birth; both are the seller's and manufacturer's claims, not a clinical review.

products.name: Sorine Infantil Jet Baby
products.basis: Name used on the shop label ('Sorine Infantil Jet Baby Descongestionante Spray 100ml', packaging photo provided by the owner, 2026-10-23) for the product 'Sorine Jet Baby'; kept as an alias so searching either name finds it.

products.name: Fly Gotas
products.basis: Packaging photo provided by the owner, 2026-10-23 (Biolab): 'Fly Gotas 150', simeticona 150 mg/mL, 'Melhora rápida da dor e do estufamento causados pelos gases', orange flavour, content 15 mL, emulsão oral, uso oral, 'Uso adulto e pediátrico'. Shop label: 'Fly Gotas 150mg/ml Laranja 15ml'. The 150 mg/mL concentration differs from Luftal drops (75 mg/mL per CMED): same ingredient, other strength.

products.name: Colicaliv
products.basis: Packaging photo provided by the owner, 2026-10-23 (Herbarium): homeopathic; Matricaria chamomilla 4CH, Mentha piperita 6CH, Magnesia phosphorica 5CH and Colocynthis 6CH, 0,25 mL/mL each; 'Auxiliar no alívio do desconforto causado por cólicas em recém-nascidos e crianças' (claim as printed, not checked by anyone); uso pediátrico, uso oral, 30 mL. Shop label: 'Colicaliv Gotas com 30ml'. A homeopathic product: never equivalent to simethicone or any medicine.
